title: The Ancient of Days
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who stops to look, and tonight Daniel sees the Son of Man come with the clouds and writes it down so others can see it too. Running to take Mom by the hand so she can see the rainbow on the hallway wall is exactly Scout’s kind of shared wonder.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Daniel saw something wonderful, and joyful discovery is Scout’s delight. In Scout’s world today: Scout finds a rainbow on the hallway wall, made by sunshine through the window glass. He runs and takes Mom by the hand so she can see it too. They stand there quietly and look. Just like Daniel seeing the bright clouds and sharing his dream, Scout learned that wonder grows bigger when you share it.
